errata.title: Book I, Chapter 27; Definition I.D19a; Theorem I.T05
errata.affected: Book I, Chapter 27; Definition I.D19a; Theorem I.T05
errata.summary: Corrects the published prime-polarity definition. The original growth-comparison clauses do not partition the primes; the corrected classifier uses the Legendre symbol (2/p), aligning Book I with the Book III bipolar classifier.
errata.correction: Replace Definition I.D19a and the proof of I.T05 with the Legendre-symbol polarity definition and the corresponding partition theorem. Treat the former growth-rate discussion as heuristic motivation, not as the theorem's classifier.

errata.title: Book III, Chapter 18; Definition III.D23; Theorem III.T13
errata.affected: Book III, Chapter 18; Definition III.D23; Theorem III.T13
errata.summary: Corrects the Jacobi-symbol convention used in the internal bipolar classifier derivation. Under the classical Jacobi convention, zero factors do not reduce to a single Legendre factor.
errata.correction: Introduce an explicit spectral Legendre convention for the CRT-local readout. The classifier and label-convergence conclusion remain unchanged; the derivation is reformulated.

errata.title: Book I, Chapter 24; Theorem I.T04
errata.summary: Tightens the Hyperfactorization Theorem statement. Conditions (i)-(iii) alone do not uniquely specify the ABCD tuple; maximal tetration height must be part of the admissibility condition.
errata.correction: Add the maximality clause already used by the greedy-peel construction and uniqueness proof. The theorem's intended canonical decomposition remains unchanged.

errata.title: Book V QNM and ringdown terminology correction
errata.affected: Book V Chapters 41, 50, 51, 53, and 56; QNM and cycle-delay Results pages
errata.summary: Corrects QNM and ringdown public language. The Kerr primary ringdown depends on remnant mass and spin; the tau prediction is the leading-order T² ratio f_(0,1)/f_(1,0)=ιτ^-1. The former echo/no-echo language is split into two categories: no exotic reflective-surface ECO echoes, but released T² cycle-delay/ringdown observables remain as topology-readout candidates. It also repairs generated-page contamination on QNM and cycle-delay prediction/falsification pages.
errata.correction: Update Book V source text, TauLib comments/projection labels, Corpus registry/results data, and public pages so QNM ratio direction, cycle-delay ratio direction, and echo terminology are consistent. Remove CKM/Wolfenstein and proton-radius bleed-through from QNM and cycle-delay pages. Public status remains released-corrected, not hidden or validated.
